title: Pit advice
help: Disabled by default. Suggests cars at 5/15 or below, lowest fuel first. Requires FUEL ON, CU data less than five seconds old and pit telemetry.
limits: Advice only: check places before entering. The CU reports the pit lane, not individual left/right bay occupancy. No switch or waiting order is controlled.
unavailable: Fresh CU data and FUEL ON are required.
